chunks: Hamza b. Muhammad al-Alawi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim informed me from his father from Muhammad b. Abi Umayr from Malik al-Juhni. He said:

I gave Aba Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) a fragrance. He took it, smelled it, and placed it on his eyes, then said: Whoever takes a fragrance, smells it, and places it on his eyes, then says: "O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad," it will not fall to the earth before he is forgiven.

key_terms.الرياحين: fragrant herbs/sweet basil, aromatic plants used in Islamic culture
key_terms.صل على محمد وآل محمد: bless Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad, the salawat formula

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about smelling fragrance and reciting salawat?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a personal interaction with Imam al-Sadiq (AS), where the narrator offered him a sweet-smelling herb. The Imam demonstrated the proper etiquette of receiving fragrance: smelling it, placing it on the eyes, and invoking blessings upon the Prophet and his family. The Imam then taught that whoever performs this act with the salawat will be forgiven before the fragrance even touches the ground, highlighting the spiritual power of combining gratitude for natural blessings with remembrance of the Prophet.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Hamza b. Muhammad al-`Alawi (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim informed me from my father from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Malik al-Juhni. He said:

I gave Aba `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) a fragrance. So, he took it, smelled it, put it to his eyes, and said: Whoever takes a fragrance, smells it, puts it to his eyes, and says: “May Allah bless Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad (allahumma salli `ala muhammadan wa aali Muhammad)”, he will not leave the Earth except that he will be forgiven.
